​
Stating that the Iranian delegation’s efforts were focused on articulating the country’s positions and pursuing the summit’s established objectives, the President said the key themes addressed included resilience, innovation, cooperation, and sustainability.
​
He also hailed the participating nations’ positive stance on issues such as support for multilateralism, trade in national currencies, opposition to unilateral sanctions, and condemnation of attacks on nuclear facilities and civilian infrastructure.
​

​

​
Pezeshkian also referred to his constructive talks with the heads of state from Malaysia, South Africa, Ethiopia, and Egypt, as well as brief discussions with his Russian and Chinese counterparts.
